hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in *frontend*) ws=frontend ;; *backend*) ws=backend ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; if [ -f "$ws/tsconfig.json" ]; then (cd "$ws" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40) || true; fi

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in *frontend*) case "$f" in *.tsx|*.ts) grep -rn "localhost:3000" frontend/src/ | head -5; n=$(grep -rn "function getTodayISO\|const getTodayISO" frontend/src/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$n" -gt 1 ] && echo "spec-convention: multiple getTodayISO() definition sites (must be 1)";; esac;; *backend*) case "$f" in *.ts) grep -rn "403" backend/src/routes/ backend/src/app.ts | head -5; grep -rn "&&" backend/src/ --include='*.ts' | grep -E "eq\(" | head -5;; esac;; esac
